examples: My room is tidy now.
Keep your desk tidy.
She has tidy hair.

more.def: Neat, with everything in its proper place.
examples: He keeps his desk tidy so he can find things easily.
The garden had tidy rows of beans.
His handwriting is small and tidy.

easy.def: What clocks tell us, like hours and minutes.
examples: What time is it?
It is time for bed.
We have no time.

more.def: The hours, days, and years that pass, or a certain point or period measured by a clock or calendar.
examples: Time passes quickly when you are having fun.
The play starts at a different time on Sundays.
In the time of the dinosaurs, there were no people.

easy.def: One turn of something that happens again and again.
examples: I read it three times.
This is the first time I swam.
Say it one more time.

more.def: One occasion when something happens, which may happen again.
examples: It was the first time that she had ridden a horse.
I have been to the aquarium four times.
Each time we visit, the baby has grown bigger.
An ant is tiny.
The baby has tiny toes.
A tiny bug sat on my hand.
A tiny seed can grow into a giant tree.
There was a tiny crack in the glass.
The kitten was so tiny that it fit in my hand.
